acceptance_predicates.description: A direct ASB cli2key live run obtains a launch only from the runtime-owned sidecar; no caller-provided endpoint, key, or sidecar identity is accepted.
The sidecar starts only the AR-1779 project-local verified cli2key bridge receipt with matching catalog identity, digest, platform, and entrypoint.
One loopback-only sidecar is retained for a normal run or bounded sweep and is reaped with private staging removed on every terminal path.

Only the ephemeral endpoint, invocation credential, and selected model reach the Codex Responses adapter; OAuth data, local keys, paths, prompts, and provider bodies never reach durable state or evidence.

Authentication, readiness, model, timeout, cancellation, crash, or cleanup failure remains a typed cli2key failure and never falls back to OpenRouter, platform API keys, replay, another provider, or Codex app-server.

Credential-free public CLI fake coverage proves install/select/run/sweep/report/compare; a separate opt-in user-authorized live development benchmark proves the bounded real bridge path with redacted evidence.

definition_of_done: The current cli2key live-execution rejection is replaced by a runtime-issued sidecar launch path with full negative coverage.
Independent review, exact-head CI, signed protected merge, and exact-main post-merge qualification pass.
